compiled_state.title: [skip-review-check]: enforcement.strategy=ci -> SKIP=false on code diffs runs redundant local review
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 4f939b9343359250407aaa5404964e82a6a0fe1f
* **enforcement.strategy:** ci
* **Caller:** plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md Step 0.5

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

When `enforcement.strategy=ci`, both Layer 1 (pre-commit review-gate) and Layer 2 (PreToolUse review-gate) emit \`HOOK_GATE: skipped reason=enforcement.strategy=ci\` and skip enforcement (per CLAUDE.md "Never Do These" rule 18). Under this strategy, CI re-runs review via the parity-uplifted llm-review job — local reviews are redundant work. COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md Step 0.5 (\`skip-review-check.sh\`) should therefore short-circuit and skip the local review pipeline (Steps 1.5-3a + Step 5) entirely when \`enforcement.strategy=ci\`, not just when the diff is docs-only.

#### Actual Behavior

\`skip-review-check.sh\` only inspects file paths to decide reviewable vs. non-reviewable. It does not consult \`enforcement.strategy\`. With strategy=ci and a code-bearing diff, observed:

\`\`\`
$ git diff HEAD --name-only | .claude/scripts/dso skip-review-check.sh
$ echo \$?
1   # SKIP_REVIEW=false → COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md runs full local review (multi-agent dispatch + record-review)
\`\`\`

The full local review then runs (classifier + tier reviewer + overlays), consuming sub-agent budget for results that are not consulted at commit time (review gates skipped under strategy=ci) and that CI will re-compute regardless. Net effect: redundant token spend on every commit when strategy=ci.

### 3. Action History

1. PR 61 was a docs-only PR, blocked because required CI checks did not run; created PR-update branch \`worktree-20260506-111039\` to add \`ci-skip.yml\` and parity script.
2. Ran \`/dso:commit\` on the resulting code-bearing diff. Step 0.5 invoked \`skip-review-check.sh\` → SKIP=false → full local review pipeline ran (classifier, standard reviewer + test-quality overlay, then a second pass after autonomous resolution).
3. Observed redundancy: this repo runs strategy=ci, so the same review will run in the CI \`llm-review\` job on push.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* **Affected workflow:** COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md Step 0.5
* **Affected script:** \`plugins/dso/scripts/skip-review-check.sh\`
* **Related rule:** CLAUDE.md "Never Do These" rule 18 (enforcement.strategy=ci skip semantics for review/test gates)

### 6. Logs

\`\`\`
$ .claude/scripts/dso read-config.sh enforcement.strategy
ci

$ git diff HEAD --name-only | .claude/scripts/dso skip-review-check.sh; echo \$?
1
\`\`\`

#### Suggested fix scope

Either (a) extend \`skip-review-check.sh\` to read \`enforcement.strategy\` and short-circuit return 0 when strategy=ci, or (b) update COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md Step 0.5 / Step 5 to consult \`enforcement.strategy\` independently and skip local review when CI is the source of truth. (a) is more localized and keeps the workflow doc simple; (b) is cleaner separation of concerns. Decide during fix.
